about: The cases a glossary of banned terms is held to: its document read, terms found on lines of their own language, terms named in a text being written, and new lines added. A refusal is its sentence under `error`; the terms a text uses are found against the banned list alone.

parseGlossary.name: entries are read from their own sections and the explanation bullets are not
args:
# Wording

## Banned terms

- Each line is `<language code> · <banned term> → <what to write>`.
- en · tool strip → toolbar
- en · fixing → editing — when it means editing
- en · slot → position

## Uses in the word's own sense

- Each line is `<language code> · <banned term> · <a phrase holding the term>`.
- en · slot · slot machine — a machine
- en · slot · coin slot — an opening

## Allowed uses

- en · fixing · docs/a.md · bike fixing — a repair
